kurz: Älplermagronen turn creamy because pasta and potatoes cook in the same water and their starch binds the sauce.
bild_im_kopf: Like a stew that cooks its own sauce: what the ingredients give off holds everything together in the end.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Cook diced potatoes and macaroni in the same pot
schluesselmomente.warum: Both release starch into the water. Some of this water later binds the cream and cheese.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Fry onion rings slowly in butter until golden brown
schluesselmomente.warum: Slowly, the onion's sugar [[karamellisierung|caramelises]]; fast, it burns on the outside.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Drain, keep some cooking water, mix with cream and grated cheese
schluesselmomente.warum: Starch from the cooking water holds cheese fat and cream together, so the sauce stays creamy rather than greasy.
The apple's acidity cuts through fat and cheese and makes the heavy dish fresher.
